sources.name: SUBTLEX-ESP

selection_procedure.method: A normalized 200-item working shortlist was assembled from the highest-frequency ranges of SUBTLEX-ESP, Spanish OpenSubtitles2018, and OpenSLR21. Exact surface forms were retained rather than collapsed into lemmas. Learner rank 1–100 reflects frequency evidence plus beginner usefulness and category balance, not a claim that the list reproduces any one source's order.
filters: Unicode-normalize to NFC and compare duplicate candidates case-insensitively
Remove numbers, punctuation-only strings, abbreviations, proper names, encoding artefacts, corpus markup, and the SUBTLEX processing artefact dialogue
Remove duplicate spellings while preserving meaningful accent contrasts
Reserve places for frequent inflected verb forms, question words, everyday nouns, adjectives, adverbs, and greetings
Require every final surface form to be attested in at least one source and useful to a beginner

classes: obscene or very narrow dialogue fillers that displaced broader beginner vocabulary

conflicting_rankings: The sources represent different registers: SUBTLEX-ESP and OpenSubtitles emphasize spoken dialogue, while OpenSLR21 emphasizes news text. SUBTLEX-ESP also omits many short grammatical forms from its published workbook. Source Rank therefore records each independent rank or n/a; Frequency Rank is the transparent learner-curated order.
source_rank_semantics: Ranks are one-based after NFC case-fold aggregation within each complete downloaded list and sorting by descending count. n/a means the exact normalized surface form was absent from that source, not that its frequency was zero.

ipa_convention.sentence_ipa: Broad connected-speech IPA between square brackets, including common intervocalic [β ð ɣ] and predictable nasal place assimilation without narrow dialect-specific reduction.
ipa_convention.variety: Modern educated neutral Spanish with seseo and yeísmo, chosen for broad international learner utility.
key_choices: c before e/i and z are /s/
single intervocalic r is /ɾ/ and trill r/rr is /r/
j and g before e/i are /x/

independent_content_confirmation: Meanings, grammatical notes, labels, example sentences, English translations, word IPA, and connected-speech sentence IPA were written and reviewed for this deck. No example sentence or translation was copied from a dictionary or frequency corpus.
